_Generated 2026-07-22 by /mol:map._

## Inventory (monorepo)

npm workspaces: `core`, `page`, `vsc-ext`. `python/` is a separate hatchling
PyPI package (not an npm workspace). Root package `molvis@0.1.1`. Shared deps:
`@molcrafts/molrs@0.9.0` (WASM), `@molcrafts/molplot@^0.1.1` +
`vega`/`vega-lite`/`vega-embed` (charts; root-level, **consumed by page only**).
Canonical in-repo source alias: **`@molvis/core`** (+ `/io`, `/io/formats`) →
`core/src/*` (tsconfig `paths` + rsbuild/rslib alias). Published npm name:
**`@molcrafts/molvis-core`**.

### Module list

**`core/` — `@molcrafts/molvis-core@0.1.1` (engine library)**
- Top-level runtime: `app.ts` (`MolvisApp`), `world.ts`, `renderer.ts`,
  `artist.ts`, `scene_index.ts`, `scene_sync.ts`, `thin_instance.ts`, `picker.ts`,
  `highlighter.ts`, `grid.ts`, `settings.ts`, `config.ts`, `events.ts`,
  `system.ts`, `entity_source.ts`, `selection_manager.ts`,
  `selection_reconciler.ts`, `frame_render_scheduler.ts`, `axis_helper.ts`,
  `target_indicator.ts`, `data_inspector.ts`, `viewport_settings.ts`,
  `dom_helpers.ts`, `save_file.ts`, `element.ts`, `element_entry.ts`,
  `web_component_runtime.ts`, `version.ts`, `index.ts`
- `commands/` — reversible `Command<T>` do()/undo(); `@command` registry
  (draw, frame, clear, selection, mark_atom, overlays, camera, snapshot,
  representation, attributes); `composite`, `manager`, `place_molecule`,
  `registry`, `base`. Full scene rebuilds via pipeline Draw path / RPC
  `scene.draw_frame`; `UpdateFrameCommand` is buffer-update-only
- `modifiers/` — pure `apply(frame,ctx)→Frame`: AssignColor, ColorByProperty,
  ComputeBonds, DeleteSelected, ExpressionSelection, HideHydrogens,
  HideSelection, Select, Slice, TransparentSelection, VectorField, WrapPBC.
  ColorByProperty config: `columnName` / `range` / `clampOutOfRange` /
  `categorical` (numeric path uses fixed viridis)
- `pipeline/` — single scene-data ingress; `DataSourceModifier` head +
  Draw{Atom,Bond,Box,Isosurface,Ribbon}, modifier_registry, bond_column_remap,
  auto_attach, nato_ids, pipeline, types
- `mode/` — view, select, edit, manipulate, measure (+ base, menu_items,
  mode_type, types, utils)
- `transport/` — `rpc/` (router, serialization, types), `trajectory_worker/`
  (runtime, worker, protocol, frame_codec), ws_bridge, event_forwarder,
  state_sync (DataSource identity via `category` / acquisition `kind`)
- `io/` — reader/writer over molrs; `formats.ts` (dependency-free public
  subpath), zarr, atom_coords, normalize_coords; `cache/` (fingerprint,
  molidx_codec, OPFS blob/index/root); `sources/` (blob_range, opfs_sync_range,
  trajectory_source)
- `system/` — trajectory, topology, frame_diff, frame_labels,
  source_composition, superposition, svd3, elements
- `analysis/` — rdf, cluster(+properties), msd, rings, exploration,
  topology_analysis, trajectory_analyses/runner, registry, requirements,
  panel_inputs, dispatch, frame_subset, utils
- `artist/` — atom/bond buffers, palette, representation, style_manager, theme,
  material_factory/spec, label_renderer, visual_guide, warmup; `isosurface/`;
  `presets/{classic,modern,vivid}`; `ribbon/`
- `camera/` — animator, auto_view, fit, interpolate, obb, pose, track
- `overlays/` — OverlayManager; Arrow2D/3D, MarkAtom, TextLabel, VectorField,
  RegionWireframeOverlay (sphere/box/cylinder/ellipsoid/plane/gaussian)
- `selection/` — expression, fence
- `ui/` — core built-in canvas overlay (distinct from page React UI)
- support: `algo/marching_cubes.ts`, `export/gltf.ts`,
  `shaders/{impostor,surface}.ts`, `utils/`
- examples: `core/examples/`

**`page/` — React 19 web app (single frontend for every host)**
- Root: `index.tsx` (`window.MolvisApp.mount`), `App.tsx`, `MolvisWrapper.tsx`
- `lib/` — `mount.tsx` (`mountMolvisApp`, `MountHostOpts`), `mount-opts.ts`
  (`MountOpts.surface` `"full"|"canvas"`, chrome flags), kekule-loader
- `hooks/` — useMolvisUiState, useBackendConnection, useBackendStateSync,
  useHostFileBridge, useTheme, useStatusMessage, useIsNarrow
- `components/` — dialogs, TimelineControl; `ui/` shadcn/Radix primitives
- `ui/layout/` — TopBar, sidebars, Settings/Export/Screenshot/StateSync,
  ClusterPanel, DataInspectorPanel, PCATool; `analysis/` (charts via molplot)
- `ui/modes/` — edit / manipulate / measure / select / view (PipelineTab,
  per-modifier property components, DnD pipeline tree)

**`vsc-ext/` — `molvis@0.1.1` (VSCode extension)**
- `extension/` — activate, configuration, types; `loading/` (formatResolver,
  molecularFileLoader, pathUtils, zarrDirectoryReaderCore, …); `panels/`
  (editorProvider, binaryEditorProvider, previewPanel, viewerPanel,
  panelRegistry, messaging, html, hotReload)
- `webview/` — bootstrap + lazy `@molvis/core` chunk, spawnTrajectoryWorker
- `viewer/` — full-page host (page App)

**`python/` — `molcrafts-molvis@0.1.1` (PyPI driver)**
- `scene.py` — `Molvis` facade (session registry, WS lifecycle, mimebundle)
  composed of 7 command mixins
- `commands/` — Drawing, Selection, Frame, Snapshot, Overlay, Palette, Pipeline
  + `FrontendCommands` catalog
- `transport/` — `WebSocketTransport` (`surface="full"|"canvas"`), `_codec`,
  `_jupyter_env`; `transport_base.py`
- Top-level: control, events, runtime, palettes, errors, cli, video, mdx, types,
  utils
- Ships page bundle as `molvis/dist/**`

### Public surface

- **core `.`** — `mountMolvis()`, `MolvisApp`/`Molvis`, `MolvisRenderer`,
  `MOLVIS_VERSION`; config/settings/events; modifiers + pipeline + DataSource;
  overlays incl. `RegionWireframeOverlay`; analysis; camera; artist (ColorMap,
  REPRESENTATIONS, themes); WASM re-exports (`Frame`/`Block`/`Box`/readers…);
  transport (`RPCRouter`, `WebSocketBridge`); `exportFrameToGLB`;
  `System`/`World`/`SelectionManager`; element types
- **core `./io`** — load/stream/write/export, zarr, `BlobRangeSource`, format
  re-exports
- **core `./io/formats`** — `FileFormat`, `FILE_FORMAT_REGISTRY`,
  `inferFormatFromFilename`, `isBinaryFormat` — **dependency-free** (host
  activation safe)
- **core `./element`**, **`./elements`** — web-component entry surfaces
- **page** — de-facto `mountMolvisApp` / `MountOpts` (`surface`, `chrome`,
  `wsUrl`, `token`, `session`, `demo`); `window.MolvisApp.mount`
- **vsc-ext** — `activate`/`deactivate`; customEditors `molvis.editor` +
  `molvis.binaryEditor`; commands (quickView, openEditor, openStructure, …);
  webview bootstrap
- **python `molvis`** — `Molvis`, `Transport`/`WebSocketTransport`, EventBus /
  Selection / ViewerState, runtime detect, palette helpers, `MolvisRPCError`;
  CLI `molvis`

### Style summary

- **core** — TS ESM; OOP domain types; immutability on frame transforms; command
  do/undo; rslib library + rsbuild demo/headless; root biome; molrs **0.9.0**
  bundler-target only
- **page** — React 19 + hooks; shadcn/Radix/Tailwind; `surface`/`chrome` chrome
  model; **only molplot consumer**; rsbuild → dist copied into python wheel
- **vsc-ext** — extension host + React webview; rslib multi-config; formats
  subpath on activation path
- **python** — snake_case + Mixins on `Molvis`; hatchling; JSON-RPC over
  WebSocket; `surface` for page chrome

### Layer roles

| Package | Role | Depends on | Must not |
|---------|------|------------|----------|
| **core** | Leaf engine library | babylon, molrs, tslog | page/vsc/python; charting; bypass pipeline head |
| **page** | Shared frontend | core (alias), molplot, React | own parsers; chart ownership outside page |
| **vsc-ext** | VSCode host | core + page patterns | reimplement IO; own charting |
| **python** | Driver over WS | page dist artifact, molpy | import core TS; own WebGL |

**DAG:** `core ← page ← vsc-ext`; `core ← vsc-ext` (webview); `python → page
bundle over WS`. No cycles. Charting confined to page. Pipeline
`DataSourceModifier` is the single scene-data ingress (GUI + RPC).
